nodes.npcText: Greetings healer! I am the tax collector of the village lord. I've come to collect the rent for the shop inside the palanka. From what I see, you've made good money. We agreed on 100 gold, but since you earned a lot, I want 120 gold from you.

choices.text: Accept to pay 120 gold.
We agreed on 100, take the 100 gold and get out.
I don't have enough gold.

nodes.npcText: Good, a smart healer. The gates of our palanka will always be open to you. Good luck with your work.
The only person around here who could look into my eyes was Borakran. And he just died. Now I can do whatever I want around here. Now you will give me the extra 20 gold I want.

choices.text: I don't have enough gold.

nodes.npcText: Hello, I am Narin. I herd the village sheep. Congratulations on your new shop.

choices.text: Okay. I don't remember names well.
Hello, I'm glad to meet you, Narin. How are you?

nodes.npcText: A lamb was born today. I carried the little one on my back to the house so it wouldn't freeze. I caught a bit of a chill. Do you have a drink that would be good for me?

choices.text: Sure, let me brew you a nice winter tea, the price is 18 gold.
Since a lamb was born today and you carried it on your back, you've earned a winter tea.
I don't have such a drink on hand.

nodes.npcText: I really liked the winter tea from the other day. I gathered some willow bark for you while herding the sheep.

choices.text: Thank you.

nodes.npcText: Because of you, the village palankas collapsed. You are greedy, may a monster take you.

choices.text: Go tend to your sheep.
I didn't do anything.

nodes.npcText: Greetings. I am Dursun, the village carpenter. Two days of my week are spent repairing the palanka. It's an old palanka; you repair one side, and another side collapses.

choices.text: What is a palanka, master?
How can I help you, master?

nodes.npcText: I cut my hand while repairing the palanka, do you have any cut salve or something to stop the bleeding?

choices.text: I have cut salve, master, it is 19 gold.
Unfortunately, I don't have cut cream, master.

nodes.npcText: A palanka is the wooden fortification surrounding the village. A village wall of sorts. It's made of a magical wood called iron juniper. But it's very old, built in my grandfather's grandfather's time, so now it's falling apart. And I cut my hand while repairing it. Do you have any cut salve?

choices.text: I have cut salve, master, the price is 19 gold.
Unfortunately, I don't have cut cream, master.

nodes.npcText: Greetings Healer. I am Fehim, Master Carpenter Dursun's apprentice. My master sent me. We can't repair the palanka due to a lack of materials. We need iron juniper blocks. If you have any, could you lend us some? We don't have money right now, but the palanka is vital for the village. My master will collect gold from the villagers and pay you later.

choices.text: Sure. Since it's vital for the village, I will lend you some iron juniper blocks, I hope your master keeps his word.
No, if I lend to everyone, the shop will go bankrupt.

nodes.npcText: May Mother Umay protect you, healer.

choices.text: Who is Mother Umay?

nodes.npcText: The great mother who brings abundance to the lands.

choices.text: I see.

nodes.npcText: Without the palanka, you won't be safe either. May a monster take you.

choices.text: Good day to you too!

nodes.npcText: My master managed to collect the gold for the iron juniper block from the villagers. Exactly 74 gold.

choices.text: Thanks. Say hello to your master.

storylines.characterName: Cevat of Rivze the Monster Slayer

nodes.npcText: Hello.

choices.text: Hello.

nodes.npcText: I am a monster slayer, Cevat of Rivze.

choices.text: Okay

nodes.npcText: You might not want my kind in your shop.

choices.text: You're talking nonsense. Monster slayers are respectable. You protect people from monsters.
I don't want disreputable people in my shop.

nodes.npcText: Hmm.

choices.text: How can I help you, Cevat?

nodes.npcText: I took a contract from Tax Collector Kazim. I need a monster web for the ligtlings, do you have one or can you prepare one? It needs to be made of iron juniper. I'll pay for it in full.

choices.text: Unfortunately no.
Sure, the iron juniper monster web is ready, you can have it for 90 gold. What is a ligtling?

nodes.npcText: Ligtlings are forest cats that can teleport. When they appear in a village, they eat the village poultry and small lambs. Safe travels, healer.

choices.text: You too, Cevat, goodbye.

nodes.npcText: They say people trade with monster slayers here. I don't deal with your kind, but ligtlings scratched my arm. It doesn't look like a normal cut. I feel like I've swallowed poison.

choices.text: Treat him.
There is no remedy for you here, treat the cut yourself.
It's none of your business who I trade with, shut your mouth if you don't want the ligtlings to scratch you more. (You demand an extra 20 gold)

nodes.npcText: Healer, my foot is badly burned, prepare a remedy for me.

choices.text: How did your foot get burned?

nodes.npcText: Ligtlings raided the blacksmith forge. While escaping from them, I stuck my foot into the forge hearth. But our money goes to palanka repairs and the ligtlings also attacked the villagers' chickens. So, as you understand, I have no money. Would you accept some garlic grown by my wife instead?

choices.text: Your burn salve is ready, alright I accept the garlic.
No way, I pay rent too and this place is not a charity.

nodes.npcText: Easy days, healer. I'm going to cook, do you have anything I can use as a spice?

choices.text: I have thyme, it adds flavor to your food. It's yours for 13 gold.
This is not an inn. And I am not a chef.

nodes.npcText: Healer, I am very hungry. Do you have anything to fill my stomach?

choices.text: I can give you some honey.
This is not an inn, and I don't give out free food.

nodes.npcText: May Mother Umay protect you.

choices.text: You too.

nodes.npcText: Easy days, healer. I am actually very rich. But I can only spend my money in multiples of 7. How much gold do you want in return for the honey you gave the other day?

choices.text: 7 Gold.
14 Gold.
21 Gold.

nodes.npcText: I gave you 14 Gold.

choices.text: Thank you.

nodes.npcText: I gave you 21 gold.

choices.text: Thank you.

nodes.npcText: Don't be greedy, I gave you 7 gold.

choices.text: Okay.

nodes.npcText: (The shop door opened. A soldier collapsed right at the entrance of the shop. He is delirious. He sees invisible monsters. He is not aware of where he is.)

choices.text: Help him without worrying about the gold.
Wait for him to come to his senses before treating him so you can ask for gold.

nodes.npcText: (The soldier came to his senses. He went outside with difficulty. He didn't speak to you.)

choices.text: "Wait, what if I had helped..."

nodes.npcText: Thanks, healer. But I don't have any gold to give you. When I have it, I'll bring it, I am Borakran, my word is my bond.

choices.text: Alright, so be it.

nodes.npcText: I am Seren. I don't talk much. My friend Cevat died because of you. He was a monster slayer, he'd seen dragons and cursed creatures... But because of you, he became food for those filthy cats that that can teleport! Give me a naiad breath potion. I won't pay for it.

choices.text: It's not my fault, get out of my shop.
I'm sorry.

introPages.title: Welcome to Border Willow Village
introPages.text: Welcome healer. No healer has been found in our village for a long time. There is a druid at the edge of the village, but she does not care much about us. Border Willow is a small village inside an old palanka fortification. We are mostly engaged in animal husbandry and grow grain.

introPages.title: Monsters
introPages.text: Since the animal pastures remain outside the palanka, numerous monsters attack when we take our animals out to graze. For this reason, your healer skills and potions will be a remedy for us.

introPages.title: Druid Seren
introPages.text: There is a druid named Seren who lives in a small cabin on the edge of our village. She never enters the village, but if you see her, it is useful to be respectful.

introPages.title: Cabin Rent
introPages.text: Every 7th day of the week, someone will come to collect the cabin rent of 100 gold. Don't forget to prepare the gold and pay the rent.

news.text: The druid, who hadn't been seen in the village for years, left their cabin and was spotted in the village square.

conditionalNews.text: Due to a lack of materials, Carpenter Dursun and Apprentice Fehim could not repair the palanka. The palanka collapsed in several places. The village was left defenseless against monsters.

The palanka was repaired by Carpenter Dursun and his apprentice Fehim. Our village was protected from large monsters, but ligtlings slipped into the village during the repairs. They are attacking our chickens and small lambs.
The white-haired monster slayer was found dead.
Cevat solved the village's ligtling problem.
Our village's old veteran Borakran died. A funeral will be held for him.

events.text: No iron juniper blocks were lent to the carpenter's apprentice.
Cevat was kicked out of the healer shop.
Borakran was helped without asking for gold.
Borakran was not treated in the healer shop.
When Borakran died, Kazim became the new bully of the village. Now no one can stand against him.
Borakran was saved and gold was spent on the palanka.
Seren was kicked out of the shop.

pages.endText:
Ending: Not Bad

You continue to be the village healer. The demo ends here, you can play again if you want and try to get another ending.You can visit our Steam page to see other games set in the Sorcerum universe.

Ending: The village's unpopular healer

Borakran's death was met with great sadness in the village. The villagers know that you didn't help him and they look at you with spite. Borakran's death turned Tax Collector Kazim into the village bully.

The demo ends here, you can play again if you want and try to get another ending. You can click the button below to see our other games set in the Sorcerum universe.

Ending: River Moss

Seren turned you into a river moss because you were disrespectful to her and her friend Cevat is dead. The demo ends here, you can play again if you want and try to get another ending.You can visit our Steam page to see other games set in the Sorcerum universe.

Ending: Bankrupt

You couldn't pay the rent, so you were evicted. The demo ends here, you can play again if you want and try to get another ending.You can visit our Steam page to see other games set in the Sorcerum universe.

tr.intro.text.intro_2: Ancak vadi artık eskisi gibi huzurlu değil. Ormandan yükselen kirli büyüler nehir ruhlarını delirtiyor, Alkarıları masum köylülerin rüyalarına musallat oluyor. Şifalı ellerinle doğru bitkileri bir araya getirmeli, her derde deva iksirler kaynatmalısın.
tr.intro.text.intro_3: Unutma, bu dünyada hayatta kalmak sadece şifa dağıtmaktan ibaret değil. Her 7 günde bir Tahsildar Kazım kapını çalarak dükkan kirasını (100 Altın) isteyecek. Kasandaki altınları iyi yönet, aksi takdirde dükkanın mühürlenebilir!

tr.node.node_d_shepherdNarin_1.npcText: Merhaba, ben Narin. Köyün koyunlarını güderim. Dükkanın hayırlı olsun.
tr.choice.node_d_shepherdNarin_1.1: Merhaba, seninle tanıştığıma memnun oldum Narin. Nasılsın?
tr.node.node_d_shepherdNarin_2300.npcText: Bugün bir kuzu doğdu. Üşümesin diye yavruyu sırtımda taşıyıp eve götürdüm. Biraz üşüttüm. Bana iyi gelecek bir içeceğin var mı?
tr.choice.node_d_shepherdNarin_2300.0: Tabii, sana güzel bir kış çayı demleyeyim, fiyatı 18 altın.
tr.choice.node_d_shepherdNarin_2300.1: Since a lamb was born today and you carried it on your back, you've earned a winter tea.
tr.node.node_d_shepherdNarin_8642.npcText: Geçen günki kış çayını çok beğendim. Koyun güderken senin için biraz söğüt kabuğu çıkardım.
tr.node.node_d_carpenterDursun_1.npcText: Selam olsun. Ben köyün marangozu Dursun. Bir haftanın iki günü palanka'nın tamiratıyla geçiyor. Eski bir palanka bir tarafı tamir etsen bir tarafı çöküyor.
tr.node.node_d_carpenterDursun_1056.npcText: Palankayı tamir ederken elimi kestim, elinde biraz kesik merhemi ya da kanı durduracak bir şeyler var mı?
tr.node.node_d_carpenterDursun_5531.npcText: Palanka köyün etrafını saran ahşap tahkimattır. Yani bir nevi köy suru. Demir ardıç dediğimiz büyülü ağaçtan yapılmıştır. Ama çok eski, babamın babası zamanında yapılmış, o yüzden şimdi dökülüyor. Ben de onu tamir ederken elimi kestim. Kesik merhemin var mı?
tr.choice.node_d_carpenterDursun_5531.0: Kesik merhemim var usta, fiyatı 19 altın.
tr.choice.node_d_carpenterDursun_5531.1: Maalesef elimde kesik kremi yok usta.
tr.choice.node_d_carpenterDursun_1056.1: Maalesef elimde kesik kremi yok usta.
tr.node.node_fehim_1.npcText: Selam Şifacı. Ben marangoz Dursun'un çırağı Fehim. Beni ustam gönderdi. Malzeme yetersizliğinden palankayı onaramıyoruz. Demir Ardıç bloklarına ihtiyacımız var. Elinde bulunursa bize biraz ödünç vermen mümkün mü? Şimdi paramız yok ama palanka köy için çok önemli. Ustam köylülerden para toplayıp paranı sonra ödeyecek.
tr.choice.node_fehim_1.0: Olur. Madem köy için çok önemli size biraz demir ardıç bloğu ödünç vereceğim, umarım ustan sözünde durur.
tr.choice.node_fehim_1.1: Olmaz, herkese ödünç verirsem dükkan batar.
tr.node.node_fehim_4917.npcText: Palanka olmadan sen de güvende olmayacaksın. Seni canavar kapsın.
tr.node.node_d_shepherdNarin_9582.npcText: Senin yüzünden köyün palankaları çöktü. Aç gözlüsün, seni canavar kapsın.
tr.char.story_monsterSlayerCevat: Cevat of Rivze the Monster Slayer
tr.node.node_monsterSlayerCevat_6699.npcTex: Ben bir canavar avcısıyım, Rivze'li Cevat.
tr.choice.node_monsterSlayerCevat_1995.0: Saçmalıyorsun. Canavar avcıları saygındır. İnsanları canavarlardan koruyorsunuz.
tr.node.node_monsterSlayerCevat_6518.npcTex: Tahsildar Kazım'dan bir kontrat aldım. Işıldaklar için canavar ağına ihtiyacım var, elinde var mı ya da bir tane hazırlayabilir misin? Demir ardıçtan yapılması gerekiyor. Karşılığını tamı tamına öderim.
tr.choice.node_monsterSlayerCevat_6518.1: Sure, the iron juniper monster web is ready, you can have it for 90 gold. What is a ligtling?
tr.node.node_monsterSlayerCevat_6561.npcTex: Işıldaklar ışınlanabilen orman kedileridir. Bir köyde ortaya çıktıklarında köyün kümes hayvanlarını ve ufak kuzuları yerler. Yolun açık olsun şifacı.
tr.node.node_farmerKalender_1.npcText: Burada canavar avcılarıyla ticaret yapılıyormuş. Sizin gibilerle işim olmaz ama ışıldaklar kolumu çizdi. Normal bir kesiğe benzemiyor. Zehir yutmuş gibi hissediyorum.
tr.choice.node_farmerKalender_1.1: Sana burada şifa yok, kesiği kendin tedavi et.
tr.node.node_blacksmithRüstem_1.npcText: Şifacı ayağım fena yandı, bana bir şifa hazırla.
tr.node.node_blacksmithRüstem_3676.npcText: Demircihaneyi ışıldaklar bastı. Onlardan kaçarken ayağımı demirci ocağına soktum. Ama paramız palanka tamiratlarına gidiyor ve ışıldaklar da köylünün tavuklarına saldırdı. Yani anlayacağın param yok. Sana eşimin kendi yetiştirdiği sarımsaklardan versem kabul eder misin?
tr.choice.node_blacksmithRüstem_3676.0: Yanık kremin hazır, peki sarımsakları kabul ediyorum.
tr.node.node_zenal_1.npcText: Kolay gelsin şifacı. Yemek yapacağım, baharat olarak kullanabileceğim bir şeylerin var mı?
tr.choice.node_zenal_1.0: Kekiğim var, yemeğine tat katar. 13 altına senindir.
tr.choice.node_zenal_1.1: Burası bir han değil. Ben de bir aşçı değilim.
tr.node.node_crazyMan_1.npcText: Şifacı karnım çok aç. Karnımı doyurabilecek bir şeyin var mı?
tr.choice.node_crazyMan_1.1: Burası bir han değil, bedava aş da vermiyorum.
tr.node.node_crazyMan_4204.npcText: Kolay gelsin şifacı. Ben aslında çok zenginim. Ama paramı 7'nin katları olarak harcayabilirim. Geçen gün verdiğin balın karşılığı olarak kaç altın istersin?
tr.node.node_crazyMan_0841.npcText: Aç gözlülük etme, sana 7 altın verdim.
tr.potion.d_ironLeafBlock.name: Demir Ardıç Blok
tr.node.node_fehim_2180.npcText: Ustam köylülerden demir ardıç bloğunun parasını toplamayı başardı. Tamı tamına 74 altın.
tr.node.node_landlord_demand.npcText: Selam şifacı! Köyün beyinin tahsildarıyım ben. Palankanın içindeki dükkan kirasını tahsil etmeye geldim.Gördüğüm kadarıyla iyi para kazanmışsın. 100 altına anlaşmıştık ama madem çok para kazandın senden 120 altın istiyorum.
tr.choice.node_landlord_demand.1: 100 altına anlaştık, 100 altını al ve defol.
tr.node.node_landlord_angry.npcText: Buralarda benim gözlerime bakabilen tek kişi Borakran'dı. O da yeni öldü. Artık buralarda istediğimi yapabilirim. Şimdi bana istediğim fazladan 20 altını vereceksin.
tr.node.node_Borakran_1.npcText: (Dükkanın kapısı açıldı. Bir asker hemen dükkanın girişine yıkıldı. Sayıklıyor. Görünmez canavarlar görüyor. Nerede olduğunun bilincinde değil.)
tr.choice.node_Borakran_1.1: Para isteyebilmek için tedavi etmeden önce kendine gelmesini bekle.
tr.node.node_Borakran_1272.npcText: (Asker kendine geldi. Zorlanarak dışarı çıktı. Seninle konuşmadı.)
tr.choice.node_farmerKalender_1.2: Kiminle ticaret yapıyorsam yapıyorum sanane, ışıldaklar seni daha fazla tırmalamasın istiyorsan kes sesini. (Fazladan 20 altın talep ediyorsun)
tr.choice.node_blacksmithRüstem_3676.1: Olmaz, ben de kira ödüyorum ve burası bir hayır kurumu değil.
tr.node.node_Borakran_6494.npcText: Sağol şifacı. Ama sana verecek param yok. Olduğunda getireceğim, ben Borakran, sözüm sözdür.
tr.node.node_druidSeren_1.npcText: I am Seren. I don't talk much. My friend Cevat died because of you. He was a monster slayer, he'd seen dragons and cursed creatures... But because of you, he became food for those filthy cats that that can teleport! Give me a naiad breath potion. I won't pay for it.
tr.choice.node_druidSeren_1.0: Benim bir suçum yok, defol dükkanımdan.

en.intro.text.intro_1: You open the door of the old, dusty cabin left by your grandfather. The scent of dried herbs and the faint steam rising from the cauldron take you back to your childhood. You are the last hope in this valley now.
en.intro.text.intro_2: But the valley is no longer peaceful. Vile spells rising from the forest drive river spirits mad, and Alkarisi haunt the dreams of innocent villagers. You must combine the right herbs with healing hands and brew potions to cure all ailments.
en.intro.title.intro_3: The Shadow of the Tax Collector
en.intro.text.intro_3: Remember, surviving in this world is not just about healing. Every 7 days, Kazim the Tax Collector will knock on your door to collect rent (100 Gold). Manage your gold wisely, or your shop might be sealed!
en.soundtrack.track_1.title: Ancient Cabin Melody
en.soundtrack.track_2.title: Whispering Shadows
en.soundtrack.track_3.title: Alchemy Fire Soundtrack
en.intro.text.intro_welcome_1: Welcome healer. No healer has been found in our village for a long time. There is a druid at the edge of the village, but they don't care much about us. Border Willow is a small village inside an old palanka fortification. We are mostly engaged in animal husbandry and grow grain.
en.intro.text.intro_welcome_2: Since the animal pastures remain outside the palanka, numerous monsters attack when we take our animals out to graze. For this reason, your healer skills and potions will be a remedy for us.
en.intro.text.intro_welcome_3: There is a druid named Seren who lives in a small cabin on the edge of our village. They never enter the village, but if you see them, it is useful to be respectful.
en.intro.text.intro_welcome_4: Every 7th day of the week, someone will come to collect the cabin rent of 100 gold. Don't forget to prepare the gold and pay the rent.

en.node.node_d_shepherdNarin_1.npcText: Hello, I am Narin. I herd the village sheep. Congratulations on your new shop.
en.choice.node_d_shepherdNarin_1.0: Okay. I don't remember names well.
en.choice.node_d_shepherdNarin_1.1: Hello, I'm glad to meet you, Narin. How are you?
en.node.node_d_shepherdNarin_2300.npcText: A lamb was born today. I carried the little one on my back to the house so it wouldn't freeze. I caught a bit of a chill. Do you have a drink that would be good for me?
en.choice.node_d_shepherdNarin_2300.0: Sure, let me brew you a nice winter tea, the price is 18 gold.
en.choice.node_d_shepherdNarin_2300.1: Since a lamb was born today and you carried it on your back, you've earned a winter tea. Besides, you are my first customer.
en.choice.node_d_shepherdNarin_2300.2: I don't have such a drink on hand.
en.node.node_d_shepherdNarin_8642.npcText: I really liked the winter tea from the other day. I gathered some willow bark for you while herding the sheep.
en.node.node_d_carpenterDursun_1.npcText: Greetings. I am Dursun, the village carpenter. Two days of my week are spent repairing the palanka. It's an old palanka; you repair one side, and another side collapses.
en.choice.node_d_carpenterDursun_1.1: How can I help you, master?
en.node.node_d_carpenterDursun_1056.npcText: I cut my hand while repairing the palanka, do you have any cut salve or something to stop the bleeding?
en.choice.node_d_carpenterDursun_1056.0: I have cut salve, master, it is 19 gold.
en.node.node_d_carpenterDursun_5531.npcText: A palanka is the wooden fortification surrounding the village. A village wall of sorts. It's made of a magical wood called iron juniper. But it's very old, built in my grandfather's grandfather's time, so now it's falling apart. And I cut my hand while repairing it. Do you have any cut salve?
en.choice.node_d_carpenterDursun_5531.0: I have cut salve, master, the price is 19 gold.
en.choice.node_d_carpenterDursun_5531.1: Unfortunately, I don't have cut cream, master.
en.choice.node_d_carpenterDursun_1056.1: Unfortunately, I don't have cut cream, master.
en.node.node_fehim_1.npcText: Greetings Healer. I am Fehim, Master Carpenter Dursun's apprentice. My master sent me. We can't repair the palanka due to a lack of materials. We need iron juniper blocks. If you have any, could you lend us some? We don't have money right now, but the palanka is vital for the village. My master will collect gold from the villagers and pay you later.
en.choice.node_fehim_1.0: Sure. Since it's vital for the village, I will lend you some iron juniper blocks, I hope your master keeps his word.
en.choice.node_fehim_1.1: No, if I lend to everyone, the shop will go bankrupt.
en.node.node_fehim_6756.npcText: May Mother Umay protect you, healer.
en.node.node_fehim_8942.npcText: The great mother who brings abundance to the lands.
en.node.node_fehim_4917.npcText: Without the palanka, you won't be safe either. May a monster take you.
en.node.node_d_shepherdNarin_9582.npcText: Because of you, the village palankas collapsed. You are greedy, may a monster take you.
en.char.story_monsterSlayerCevat: Cevat of Rivze the Monster Slayer
en.node.node_monsterSlayerCevat_6699.npcTex: I am a monster slayer, Cevat of Rivze.
en.node.node_monsterSlayerCevat_1995.npcTex: You might not want my kind in your shop.
en.choice.node_monsterSlayerCevat_1995.0: You're talking nonsense. Monster slayers are respectable. You protect people from monsters.
en.choice.node_monsterSlayerCevat_1995.1: I don't want disreputable people in my shop.
en.choice.node_monsterSlayerCevat_2193.0: How can I help you, Cevat?
en.node.node_monsterSlayerCevat_6518.npcTex: I took a contract from Tax Collector Kazim. I need a monster web for the ligtlings, do you have one or can you prepare one? It needs to be made of iron juniper. I'll pay for it in full.
en.choice.node_monsterSlayerCevat_6518.1: Sure, the iron juniper monster web is ready, it can be yours for 90 gold. What is a ligtling?
en.node.node_monsterSlayerCevat_6561.npcTex: Ligtlings are forest cats that can teleport. When they appear in a village, they eat the village poultry and small lambs. Safe travels, healer.
en.node.node_farmerKalender_1.npcText: They say people trade with monster slayers here. I don't deal with your kind, but ligtlings scratched my arm. It doesn't look like a normal cut. I feel like I've swallowed poison.
en.choice.node_farmerKalender_1.1: There is no remedy for you here, treat the cut yourself.
en.node.node_blacksmithRüstem_1.npcText: Healer, my foot is badly burned, prepare a remedy for me.
en.choice.node_blacksmithRüstem_1.0: How did your foot get burned?
en.node.node_blacksmithRüstem_3676.npcText: Ligtlings raided the blacksmith forge. While escaping from them, I stuck my foot into the forge hearth. But our money goes to palanka repairs and the ligtlings also attacked the villagers' chickens. So, as you understand, I have no money. Would you accept some garlic grown by my wife instead?
en.choice.node_blacksmithRüstem_3676.0: Your burn salve is ready, alright I accept the garlic.
en.node.node_zenal_1.npcText: Easy days, healer. I'm going to cook, do you have anything I can use as a spice?
en.choice.node_zenal_1.0: I have thyme, it adds flavor to your food. It's yours for 13 gold.
en.choice.node_zenal_1.1: This is not an inn. And I am not a chef.
en.node.node_crazyMan_1.npcText: Healer, I am very hungry. Do you have anything to fill my stomach?
en.choice.node_crazyMan_1.0: I can give you some honey.
en.choice.node_crazyMan_1.1: This is not an inn, and I don't give out free food.
en.node.node_crazyMan_4204.npcText: Easy days, healer. I am actually very rich. But I can only spend my money in multiples of 7. How much gold do you want in return for the honey you gave the other day?
en.node.node_crazyMan_0841.npcText: Don't be greedy, I gave you 7 gold.
en.potion.d_ironLeafBlock.name: Iron Juniper Block
en.node.node_fehim_2180.npcText: My master managed to collect the gold for the iron juniper block from the villagers. Exactly 74 gold.
en.choice.node_fehim_2180.0: Thanks. Say hello to your master.
en.node.node_landlord_demand.npcText: Greetings healer! I am the tax collector of the village lord. I've come to collect the rent for the shop inside the palanka. From what I see, you've made good money. We agreed on 100 gold, but since you earned a lot, I want 120 gold from you.
en.choice.node_landlord_demand.1: We agreed on 100, take the 100 gold and get out.
en.node.node_landlord_angry.npcText: The only person around here who could look into my eyes was Borakran. And he just died. Now I can do whatever I want around here. Now you will give me the extra 20 gold I want.
en.node.node_Borakran_1.npcText: (The shop door opened. A soldier collapsed right at the entrance of the shop. He is delirious. He sees invisible monsters. He is not aware of where he is.)
en.choice.node_Borakran_1.0: Help him without worrying about the gold.
en.choice.node_Borakran_1.1: Wait for him to come to his senses before treating him so you can ask for gold.
en.node.node_Borakran_1272.npcText: (The soldier came to his senses. He went outside with difficulty. He didn't speak to you.)
en.choice.node_farmerKalender_1.2: It's none of your business who I trade with, shut your mouth if you don't want the ligtlings to scratch you more. (You demand an extra 20 gold)
en.choice.node_blacksmithRüstem_3676.1: No way, I pay rent too and this place is not a charity.
en.node.node_Borakran_6494.npcText: Thanks, healer. But I don't have any gold to give you. When I have it, I'll bring it, I am Borakran, my word is my bond.
en.node.node_druidSeren_1.npcText: I am Seren. I don't talk much. My friend Cevat died because of you. The villagers couldn't get rid of the ligtlings. Give me a naiad breath potion. I won't pay for it.
en.choice.node_druidSeren_1.0: It's not my fault, get out of my shop.
